verdict.rationale: Modal's docs emphasize speed and scale ('spin up hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds', 'more performant Sandbox backend') and community evidence confirms sandboxes are used for scalable, on-demand workloads, but no evidence pack item gives concrete documented cold-start latency numbers (sub-second or few-second) for starting an individual sandbox. missing for 10: explicit documented cold-start benchmark numbers (e.g., 'X ms/sec to start'), independent latency measurements/hands-on timing tests, and any SLA or performance guarantee specifically about sandbox startup time rather than aggregate concurrency claims.
